description: Cases for the two trust evaluators (TrustEvaluator.java, LocalEvaluator in trust-client). 'pem:NAME', 'pki:NAME' (base64 DER), 'crl:NAME', 'sha256:NAME' (base64url certificate hash), 'aki:NAME' (subject key identifier) and 'subject:NAME' (subject name) refer to conformance/pki. vectors.json is generated from this file by the service: see conformance/README.md.

vec-by-long-subject.name: Known by a subject name with an organizationIdentifier

vec-a-by-uri.name: Known by a URI name, authorized for one type

vec-by-bmp-subject.name: Known by a subject whose common name is a BMPString

vec-rsa-names.name: Known by key identifier and by subject

vec-pin-revoked.name: Revoked, pins a Document Signer of the registered IACA

vec-pin-suspended.name: Suspended, pins a Document Signer of the registered IACA

vec-pin-ended.name: Registration ended, pins a Document Signer of the registered IACA

vec-pin-both-revoked.name: Revoked, pins a Document Signer an active entity pins too

vec-pin-both-active.name: Active, pins a Document Signer a revoked entity pins too

vec-shared-pin-revoked.name: Revoked, pins a signer under the shared anchor an active entity pins too

vec-shared-pin-active.name: Active, pins a signer under the shared anchor a revoked entity pins too

vec-named-pin-revoked.name: Revoked, pins a signer whose DNS name an active entity is registered by

vec-named-active.name: Active, registered by the DNS name of a signer a revoked entity pins

vec-hashed-revoked.name: Revoked, names by its hash a signer whose DNS name an active entity is registered by

vec-hashed-active.name: Active, registered by the DNS name of a signer a revoked entity names by its hash
